newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Muhammad calls for efforts to promote bilateral economic ties with Saudi Arabia.
- Saudi Arabia to sell abandoned DC-8 plane by public auction.
- Saudi Arabia satisfied with passenger sales peformance by national carrier, Saudi Arabian Airlines.
- Saudi Arabian farmers start receiving wheat and barley payments worth 4.89 billion riyals.
- Moroccan firm seeks to invest in Saudi mineral resources.
- Saudi Arabia and the Philippines exchanged trade worth $1.7 billion in 1995. Riyadh's exports to Manila stood at $1.6 billion, a Filipino official says.
- $125 billion in expected investments in Saudi Arabia's sixth five-year development, launched in 1995.
